name: io.github.ewertonslv/evolution-whatsapp-mcp
title: Evolution WhatsApp
description: Send and read WhatsApp messages, send media and manage instances via the Evolution API.

environmentVariables.name: EVOLUTION_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Evolution API server, e.g. http://localhost:8080. Use https outside localhost.

environmentVariables.name: EVOLUTION_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Evolution API key, sent as the apikey header.

environmentVariables.name: EVOLUTION_DEFAULT_INSTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Default instance used when a tool call omits the instance argument.

environmentVariables.name: EVOLUTION_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide every tool that sends or changes state (send_text, send_media, create_instance, disconnect_instance, configure_webhook).

environmentVariables.name: EVOLUTION_CONFIRM_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to require a human confirmation (confirmation card or elicitation dialog) before send_text, send_media, create_instance, disconnect_instance or configure_webhook run. Clients that can show neither are refused. Default false.

environmentVariables.name: EVOLUTION_ALLOWED_NUMBERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated phone numbers that send_text and send_media may reach. Empty means no restriction.
